verdict.rationale: Pipecat is a code-first voice-agent framework with a cloud deploy target, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back bots or flows is a fair question to ask of it. The pack documents no versioning, change review, or rollback for agents or deployments. Pipecat Evals (behavioral testing) and the `pipecat cloud` deploy command are adjacent features and do not deliver this story; tracking the bot code in git would be a user-side workaround.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
